items.name: CPhysicsState::CPhysicsState
items.role: Initialises the persisted physics object state (CPhysicsState+0x13c) to 0 once; nothing in load or save writes it.

items.name: CPhysicsState::SetCollisionMaterial
items.role: Rewrites the object material list on every MaterialListChanged. Harvest also tagged the same address as bare SetCollisionMaterial (movers.cpp:207).

items.name: SetRiderController
items.role: Sets the rider controller after the mover snap; decayed at the end of every movement tick. Class not named in source.

items.name: ApplyMotionState
items.role: Absolute motion-state write used by the grounded mover (PredictMotion and ApplyMotionState are both absolute). Class not named in source.

items.name: copy_collision_info_list_into
items.role: Appends a collision info list into the destination; never clears it.

items.name: NPhysicsUtils::get_rider_controller_offset
items.role: Returns the rider pose delta (R+0x1100 minus R+0x1128, plus rotation term) for an unrotated rider. Harvest also tagged the same address as bare get_rider_controller_offset.

items.name: CPhysicsObject
items.role: Caller that stores zero into the physics object state at construction (wzr).

items.name: FindOverlap
items.role: Near-list builder: platform triangles are appended after terrain, ordered by object index.

items.name: CheckCollision
items.role: World collision query the shipped mover uses; walks each object candidate list per call with no leaf cache.

items.name: CheckCollision
items.role: Near-list collision walk: an object is left out unless its own collision filter passes us.

items.name: CheckCollision_Boolean_NoPostFilter
items.role: Boolean collision check: visits an object only when its own filter passes us. Box-landing test also names it CheckCollision.

items.name: CheckGlobalCollision_Boolean_NoPostFilter
items.role: Whole-world boolean collision check, used by the collision failsafe with its filter.

items.name: CPhysicsCollisionFailsafe::DoCollisionFailsafe
items.role: Failsafe wrapper for the stepped mover: runs the core with the collision filter, then the failsafe filter, and returns the translation to set.

items.name: DoCollisionFailsafe
items.role: Terrain-only failsafe run on every loop exit of the grounded mover.

items.name: SelectPush
items.role: Picks the failsafe push translation from the contact list (header also calls 0xc1fc54 the failsafe core).

items.name: DoTunnelingFailsafe
items.role: Tunnelling check: applies only when the move is longer than the bounds smallest half-extent.

items.name: RayIntersection
items.role: Ray test over the swept near list (no Character or CollisionActor), used by the tunnelling failsafe.

items.name: PredictMotion
items.role: Predicts the next motion state; adds the rider pose delta to the predicted translation.

items.name: CPhysicsSweptMoverCollider::MoveObject
items.role: Swept mover of the morph ball; the port does not implement it.
items.used_by: cited as source; the port does NOT implement this function

items.name: CActorMP1::PreRender
items.role: Actor pre-render: re-poses a clipped actor whose dirty shadow box is in view.

items.name: PreRenderShadow
items.role: Shadow pre-render: the shadow of an off-screen animated actor follows its animation.

items.name: CPhysicsActorMP1::SetupPhysicsObject
items.role: Defines the mover filters: collision filter 0x1270 is the material filter; failsafe filter 0x1290 is Include Solid, Exclude Character and CollisionActor. Harvest also tagged the address as bare SetupPhysicsObject.

items.name: SetupPhysicsObject
items.role: Snapshots the mover step-up and step-down tweak values at construction.

items.name: SetupPhysicsObject
items.role: Sets the ground velocity damp factor to 1.0 for every CPhysicsActorMP1, so only vertical velocity is zeroed for the player.

items.name: CPhysicsActorMP1::MaterialListChanged
items.role: Rewrites the actor material bits in translated form whenever its material list changes.

items.name: PrePhysicsUpdate
items.role: Teleports the physics object to its new pose before the step and resets the previous pose with it.

items.name: PostPhysicsUpdate
items.role: Derives the ground and air messages from the persisted object state after the move.

items.name: PreApplyForces
items.role: Pre step of the player airborne integrator: folds the entry impulse into the momentum once before the move.

items.name: Post
items.role: Post step of the player split integrator: adds dt times (force plus persistent momentum) after the loop and snap. Bare name; class not named in source.

items.name: NGamePhysicsUtilsMP1::TranslateMP1Material
items.role: Translates MP1 material-list bits into the translated material form the port filters on.

items.name: NGamePhysicsUtilsMP1::TranslatePositive
items.role: Maps the MP1 Platform channel to filter bit 0x2, the exception to the floor-eligibility rule.

items.name: CPlayerMP1::GroundCheckForOffGroundMoverCollider
items.role: Landing check for the airborne mover: probe and landing band along the up axis. Harvest also tagged the address as bare GroundCheckForOffGroundMoverCollider.

items.name: CPlayerMP1::ImpactResponseForOffGroundMoverCollider
items.role: Per-contact impact response for the airborne mover (floor and wall classification, then response).

items.name: SetPlayerHitWallDuringMove
items.role: Sets the hit-wall-during-move flag (0x2000, acceleration index 1).

items.name: CPlayerMP1::UpdateGrappleState
items.signature: void UpdateGrappleState(const CFinalInput& input, CStateManager& mgr)
items.role: Remastered grapple update: only breaks a grapple in progress and does not re-add the ground collider each tick.

items.name: CCameraManagerMP1::UpdateFilters
items.role: Remastered camera filters: no fog, only the water filter colour multiplied in, none in X-Ray or Thermal visors.

items.name: UpdateChargeRumbleTriggered
items.role: Triggers one charge rumble once the charge time passes the warm-up time.

items.name: UpdateHudDamage
items.role: Takes the damage-flash tint from Remastered own colour tables.

items.name: CIncludeExcludeCollisionFilterMP1::Passes
items.role: Non-surface material filter test; a mode-0 filter passes every material.

items.name: SurfaceCollisionPasses
items.role: Surface-level filter test for a candidate impact, using the other half outward normal.

items.name: CExcludeCollisionFilterMP1
items.role: Exclude filter, surface form: positive Exclude AND negative IncludeAll AND NOT orientation.

items.name: CIncludeCollisionFilterMP1
items.role: Include filter, surface form: positive Include OR negative ExcludeSome OR orientation.

items.name: CMorphBallMP1::Render
items.role: Morph-ball hull draw: damage flash plus boost glow colour-add.

items.name: CMorphBallMP1::FluidFXThink
items.signature: void FluidFXThink(CActor::EFluidState state, CScriptWater& water, CStateManager& mgr)
items.role: Morph-ball fluid effects with Remastered splash gating on the blue tail swoosh generator.

items.name: ComputeMovement
items.role: Movement input: Remastered leaves strafe unscaled and undoes the GameCube diagonal clamp.

items.name: CPlayerMP1::JumpInput
items.role: Jump input handling, following Remastered jump behaviour (issue 117).

items.name: SetMoveState
items.role: Ground-jump path: Remastered drops the ground collider on a ground jump so the jump moves with the off-ground mover.

items.name: CPlayerMP1::CollidedWithNew
items.role: Post-collision handler: clears the sliding-on-wall flag, sets it on a wall impact during ApplyJump, then calls SetPlayerHitWallDuringMove.

items.name: AddVisorGooSplat
items.role: Adds a visor goo splat to the Remastered visor effect manager state (Switch 1.0.0). Class not named in source.

items.name: CalculateRandomVisorGooPosition
items.role: Computes a random position for a visor goo splat.

items.name: CScriptWaterMP1::Render
items.role: Sets the water surface opacity multiplier: applied in X-Ray visor only, reset to 1 otherwise.

items.name: Load
items.role: Loads the SLdrColor_MP1Typedef sub-properties (r, g, b, a) in struct order. Bare name; class taken from the comment.

items.name: CPhazonBeamMP1::Draw
items.signature: void Draw(const bool drawSuitArm, const CStateManager& mgr, const CTransform4f& xf, const CModelFlags& flags, const CActorLights* lights) const
items.role: Base gun draw for the phazon beam; the Remastered gun model skips retail veins, clip wipe and indirect effect.

items.name: CScriptVisorGooMP1::Think
items.role: Visor goo think: Remastered keeps one persistent goo billboard that each goo splats into.

items.name: CPhysicsGroundMoverColliderMP1::MoveObject
items.role: Grounded ground-collider mover: MoveAlongGround passes, terrain failsafe on loop exit, then snap. Harvest also tagged this address as MoveObject, and DoCollisionFailsafe is a call inside it.

items.name: CanMoveUpAndDownFromPosition
items.role: Step probe: decides whether the mover can step up or down from a position; heights are contact extrema, not player origin. movers.cpp:1952 also names this address CheckCollision_Boolean_NoPostFilter.

items.name: MoveAlongGround
items.role: One grounded-mover movement pass: bisection time search with wall or floor response.

items.name: ApplyMotionState
items.role: Applies the motion state after a MoveAlongGround pass; the rider carry mode clears after the first pass.

items.name: SnapToGround
items.role: Snap pass of the grounded mover: selects the floor contact and snaps to it.

items.name: IsOnWallAtPosition
items.role: Wall test at a candidate position, listed among the grounded mover entry points.

items.name: CPhysicsSteppedMoverColliderMP1::MoveObject
items.role: Stepped (airborne) mover MoveObject: the other mover that may write the retained object state.

items.name: CPhysicsSteppedMoverColliderMP1::MoveObject
items.role: Entry writes the retained object state to 0 unconditionally; a verified airborne tick restores validity. Same qualified name as the 0xf943b4 item, different address.

items.name: DoMovementStep
items.role: Airborne mover per-step move; the landing check runs from its post-step probe.

items.name: DoMovementStep
items.role: Raises the retained object state to 1 on a grounded step.

items.name: InitMeshFilter
items.role: Excludes meshes hidden in the active visor (combat and scan, thermal, X-Ray bits); shadow passes also exclude bit 5.

items.name: UpdateShadowSampled
items.role: Shadow update: one anchor ray per update, cycling through five anchors.

items.name: UpdateShadowAnchorForExplicitHeight
items.role: Shadow cast straight down from the bounds centre; the box is 2 above to 2 below the hit; a miss clears the shadow.

items.name: init_frame
items.role: Sets the baked-lighting modulation override to 0.6 in X-Ray, replacing the colour entirely.

items.name: CBomb::Think
items.role: Remastered bomb think: BombSet every frame, BombAttract from the first attracted frame, BombExplo once detonated or in the last half second.

items.name: UpdateSwooshesAndSparks
items.role: Binds both wave-buster swooshes to the distance between the actor and the beam origin on each update.

items.name: CVector3f::skZeroVector
items.role: Static zero vector (three +0.0) used by the box-pair normal negation.
items.used_by: port reads this as the source of a constant

items.name: skClusterPixelsPerTile
items.role: Clustered-lights pixels per tile from the render debug defaults (value 48).
items.used_by: port reads this as the source of a constant

items.name: skBallNormalSwooshIntensity
items.role: Start of the morph-ball rodata swoosh intensity table; per suit values are {dry, in water}.
items.used_by: port reads this as the source of a constant

items.role: Offset of the 64x64 thermal-visor noise texture (4096 bytes) in the executable image.
items.used_by: port reads this as the source of a constant

items.role: Minimum squared magnitude below which a particle vector is not normalised (1.42e-14).
